item.description: An 11th-century pendant was found in Staraya Russa combining Christian and pagan imagery. One side depicts a warrior saint, while the other shows a snake-haired woman. The discovery highlights Staraya Russa's cultural connections and local craft production. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
